'''Mar'holt Kisfrel''' was an [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] [[General/Legends|General]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Following the [[Cleansing of Shalyvane|fall]] of [[Chinshassa]], Kisfrel was remembered as a traitor and a failure, suggesting collaboration with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.
